description: The one fixed problem P that experiments 1 to 4 solve, and whose flow and pigment settings experiment 5 uses. The grid and the number of steps are provisional: they are chosen so that a serial run takes a few minutes on a laptop. Time one run on Atlas or Vanda, then adjust them here, in this one place. The settings are written out in full, so that a change of config/defaults.json cannot change a benchmark.
